description: This file defines an interface `EntityManagerFactoryCustomizer` for customizing JPA `EntityManagerFactory` setups in a Spring-based application. It provides default methods for specifying additional packages to scan, vendor properties, and post-processors used during the entity manager factory configuration.

classes.name: EntityManagerFactoryCustomizer
classes.description: A Spring bean interface for customizing JPA EntityManagerFactory configurations, allowing registration of additional packages, vendor properties, and post-processors.

methods.name: additionalPackagesToScan
methods.description: Returns a set of package names to include in entity scanning, with a default implementation returning an empty set.

methods.name: additionalVendorProperties
methods.description: Returns a map of vendor-specific properties for fine-tuning JPA provider behavior, default is empty.

methods.name: additionalPersistenceUnitPostProcessors
methods.description: Returns a set of custom `PersistenceUnitPostProcessor` instances for further customization, default is empty.
